# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Unsure if show_artist has needed fields for names; will check then fetch names for verification.</uncertainty>
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='spotify', api_name='show_artist'))

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Need to ensure we only follow artists not currently followed; relying on show_following_artists pagination could miss some, so will check per-artist status.</uncertainty>
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K3ZpY3Bvd2VAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.idhGRJkHzxyYhU-Y-BETJurmIMNgnRedLoX32Gwu6Y4'
lked = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 31]

liked_artist_ids = set(lked)

# verify current following state per artist
status = {}
for artist_id in sorted(liked_artist_ids):
    st = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
    name = apis.spotify.show_artist(artist_id=artist_id).get('name')
    status[artist_id] = {'name': name, 'following': st.get('following') if st else None}

print('artist_following_status_count', len(status))
print('already_following', [(aid, status[aid]['name']) for aid in sorted(status) if status[aid]['following']])
print('not_following', [(aid, status[aid]['name']) for aid in sorted(status) if not status[aid]['following']])

# follow those not following
not_following_ids = [aid for aid in sorted(status) if not status[aid]['following']]
print('not_following_ids', not_following_ids)

follow_results = []
for artist_id in not_following_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
    follow_results.append((artist_id, status[artist_id]['name'], res))

print('followed_count', len(follow_results))
for artist_id, name, res in follow_results:
    print('follow', artist_id, name, '=>', res)

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
